Name: (CP) Cuter Mushroom Log
Author: hadiwrites42
Description:
I'm not sure why, maybe I'm just nitpicky, but I've yet to find a craftables retexture mod that handles the Mushroom Log. I got tired of having this neon yellow-green guy staring at me from the corner of my [font=Trebuchet MS]aesthetic[/font] farm, so I just sprited myself a neater, less eye-watering version. It's supposed to be a chopped block of wood rather than just a stump, since most mushroom cultivation uses custom-made beams/logs.

I tried to recolor to fit with Earthy Recolor and Cometkins Better Resources, but it should be alright with most recolors (and possibly vanilla? Idk, try it and see ig)

That's it, really. Nothing fancy for now, I am way out of practice, so no seasonal texture for the time being, but hopefully I'll manage to add it into Victorian Craftables sometime.

Downloads.Description: Fixed visibility issues and size. New style. Unzip into your mods folder.
